title: Director of Production Planning
text:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Production Planning leads the enterprise production planning and scheduling operating system across Karman's manufacturing operations. In this role, you will transform customer demand and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) outputs into executable production plans, capacity strategies, and recovery actions that support on-time delivery and predictable execution while providing visibility into risks, constraints, and opportunities across the manufacturing network.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads production planning, master scheduling, and finite-capacity planning across Karman manufacturing sites and value streams.
* Translates customer demand, backlog, and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) outputs into achievable production schedules with clear priorities, constraints, and recovery plans.
* Establishes planning standards and key performance indicators (KPIs) for schedule adherence, on-time delivery, past-due backlog, work-in-process (WIP) aging, capacity utilization, and plan attainment.
* Partners with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to align labor, equipment, tooling, and process capacity with production requirements.
* Coordinates with Supply Chain to identify material shortages, supplier constraints, and outside-processing risks before they affect production performance.
* Leads schedule recovery and re-baselining efforts when demand, material availability, quality issues, or capacity changes create delivery risk.
* Ensures enterprise resource planning (ERP), material requirements planning (MRP), and planning data are accurate, timely, and aligned with approved operating plans.
* Develops planners and schedulers while building a high-accountability planning organization.
* Provides executive visibility into delivery risk, capacity gaps, staffing needs, and critical decisions required to protect customer commitments.
* Improves end-to-end SIOP, planning, scheduling, and production-control processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of production planning, master scheduling, operations planning, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing planning, scheduling, or production-control teams.
* Demonstrated experience with ERP, MRP, master production schedules, capacity planning, and material requirements planning.
* Strong analytical skills and experience leading cross-functional delivery-recovery plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, space, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience with SIOP, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Power BI, or advanced manufacturing analytics.
* Knowledge of AS9100 and configuration-controlled manufacturing environments.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently communicates and works with employees in office and manufacturing environments.
* Frequently stands, walks, and uses a computer; occasionally bends, reaches, or moves throughout production areas as required by the role.
* The essential functions of this position must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Special Mentions**

* Frequent (25–50%) travel may be required to support Karman manufacturing sites.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
